sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Not available in the PvE game mode
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Cannot be put inside secure containers
- Stacks to 100
- Cannot be brought into a raid
- Only 100 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Spawns in stacks of 3-9

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
- Used as a currency to purchase expansions in the in-game Expansions Hub.
- Does not take up space in the stash, all looted TarCoins are converted into Expansions Hub balance upon extraction.
- Can also be purchased for real money on the Escape from Tarkov website or in the Expansions Hub.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Can be found in Valuables spawns with a low spawn rate
